title: Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell (hiPSC) Culture and Passaging Protocol
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Passage hiPSCs when they reach 70-80% confluency.
Aspirate the old medium from the plates.
Gently pipette to ensure single-cell suspension.

steps.title: Coat plates with Geltrex
steps.instruction: Dilute Geltrex in cold DMEM/F12 to a 1:100 ratio, add 3 mL of the diluted Geltrex to each 100 mm plate, and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour to allow coating.

steps.title: Prepare StemFlex medium
steps.instruction: Thaw StemFlex medium at room temperature and supplement it with 10 µM Y‑27632.

steps.title: Passage hiPSC colonies
steps.instruction: Aspirate the old medium from the plates, rinse cells with 3 mL PBS lacking Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺, add 3 mL Accutase to each plate, incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes until cells dissociate, gently pipette to obtain a single‑cell suspension, then transfer the cells into 10 mL StemFlex medium containing Y‑27632.

steps.title: Collect and reseed cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes, discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL StemFlex medium containing 10 µM Y‑27632, and plate the suspension onto new Geltrex‑coated plates.
